**Job Title:** QA Tester Intern  
**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Internship (Full-time)  
**Duration:** 3 months

Job Description

**Company Details:** HarEvent LLP

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented QA Tester Intern to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to start their career in Software Quality Assurance and gain hands-on experience testing real-world web applications.

As a QA Tester Intern, you will work closely with the development team to test our website, identify bugs, verify functionalities, and help improve the overall user experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform manual testing of website features and functionalities.
* Identify, document, and report bugs and errors.
* Test website navigation, forms, buttons, links, and user flows.
* Perform functional and regression testing.
* Check website responsiveness across different devices and browsers.
* Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios.
* Retest reported bugs after developers fix them.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure product quality.

Qualifications

* Basic understanding of Software Testing and QA concepts.
* Knowledge of Manual Testing.
* Understanding of website functionality and web applications.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is an added advantage.

Responsibilities and Duties  
- Candidate must have Experience in PHP or Python development.  
- Must have Working experience in JQuery/ JavaScript, HTML5/Bootstrap.  
- Knowledge of Deploying/Configuring/Securing web apps on LAMP/WAMP.  
- Knowledge of MVC & Angular JS will be an added advantage.  
- Good understanding of Object Oriented patterns and principles.  
- Database design and integration with MySQL. Good SQL/data modelling skills.  
- Knowledge of concepts and methods related to analysis, design and implementation in an object-oriented environment required.  
- Experience on product development is preferred.  
- Experience in ensuring overall code quality by performing code reviews.

Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications  
- Qualification required BCA/MCA.  
- Must be proactive and good at communication.  
- Strong interest in industry trends, technology innovation, and best practices.  
- Work closely with a talented team of engineers. Positive attitude and team oriented.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month
